name: S Novym Godom, Zerilija! - Davajte eschjo poguljaem!
original_name: С Новым годом, Зелирия! - Давайте ещё погуляем!
source:
Another New Year's story about the heroes of Zeliria Sanctuary! "Let's take another walk" tells how the life of Maxx and Velga turned out... on Earth! This a bit philosophical, a bit joyful and a bit sad story will give you a look at your favorite characters from a new side.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1857060/]Steam[/url]]
